queries: WITH circuit_counts AS (SELECT circuitId, COUNT(*) AS race_count FROM races WHERE circuitId IS NOT NULL GROUP BY circuitId), shares AS (SELECT circuitId, race_count, 1.0 * race_count / SUM(race_count) OVER () AS share FROM circuit_counts), ranked AS (SELECT circuitId, race_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY share DESC) AS share_rank FROM shares) SELECT circuitId, race_count, share, share - average_share AS excess FROM ranked WHERE share > average_share AND share_rank <= 10 ORDER BY excess DESC, circuitId;
